ideas.pitch: A robust, thread-safe configuration management module built against a rigorous test suite for the machine coding round.
ideas.problem_statement: Machine coding (Easy): build a working module against a real test suite.
ideas.title: Machine Coding Sandbox Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses strictly on passing 100 percent of the automated test cases under tight time constraints, aligning with the core judging metric of Gronex's auto-grader.

ideas.pitch: An extensible low-level design extension for a ride-sharing core codebase, adding multi-stop pooling without breaking legacy interfaces.
ideas.problem_statement: Low-level design (Hard): extend an existing codebase without breaking what already works.
ideas.title: LLD Extension Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clean object-oriented principles, design patterns, and backwards compatibility required to pass strict LLD grading suites.

ideas.pitch: A rapid log-parsing utility script designed to correlate application, database, and cache timestamps to isolate deadlock conditions during production debugging.
ideas.problem_statement: Production debugging (Hard): app, database and cache logs from a failing service. Find the root cause and fix the bug that took prod down.
ideas.title: Prod Log Root Cause Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the hardest problem type in the contest by systematically parsing distributed logs to pinpoint race conditions and failing queries instantly.

ideas.pitch: A local mock runner replicating the browser-based Gronex execution environment to pre-test code modules before final submission.
ideas.title: Gronex Workspace Test Harness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives a competitive edge by eliminating syntax and environment mismatch errors before running against the auto-grader.

ideas.pitch: An automated refactoring script that enforces solid design principles across legacy class hierarchies for LLD challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Low-level design (Hard): extend an existing codebase without breaking what already works.
ideas.title: Design Pattern Refactoring Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes code maintainability scores by automatically identifying and fixing SOLID violations in unfamiliar codebases.
